description: Every economic statement in every TTP must have full provenance. R277 upgrade: structured buyer questionnaire schema added. The first real buyer response becomes part of this ledger as a new entry with status=BUYER_VERIFIED.
format: claim → source → date → calculation → uncertainty → buyer-specific dependency → status. R277 adds: buyer_questionnaire_link → buyer_response → buyer_verified_date
constitutional_basis: Article XXVIII — modelled economics cannot be silently promoted to economic proof. The buyer questionnaire is the gate.

buyer_proof_machinery.rule: Every MODELLED or BUYER_UNVERIFIED entry below MUST have a corresponding question in the buyer questionnaire. When a buyer responds, the entry is duplicated with status=BUYER_VERIFIED and the original entry is preserved as the 'pre-verification' state.

entries.calculation: Literature review of shunt failure modes
entries.uncertainty: ±10% (varies by shunt type, patient age, follow-up duration)
entries.buyer_dependency: Buyer's specific patient population and shunt model may differ

entries.source: Industry estimates for shunt revision surgery (hospital + surgeon + imaging + follow-up)
entries.buyer_dependency: Buyer's actual cost structure, reimbursement rates, complication rates

entries.calculation: Simulator confirms system survives 24h under multi-segment failure. Whether this translates to clinical obstruction prevention is unverified.
entries.uncertainty: UNKNOWN — requires bench validation AND clinical trial
entries.buyer_dependency: Buyer's actual obstruction timecourse, patient physiology

entries.source: MODELLED — derived from EC-001 × EC-002 × EC-003

entries.buyer_dependency: All three input claims are buyer-dependent
